title: underline links only no italics emphasis
rule: Underline = links only; no italics for emphasis — italics are hard for dyslexia; use bold sparingly. Don’t combine underline+bold except the topic-page hyperlink style.
pass_when: Underline is only for links; emphasis is not italics; underline+bold only on the named topic-page hyperlink style.
fail_when: Underlined non-links; italics used for emphasis; underline+bold on ordinary text.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
